findings.message: Composition uses GSAP but no GSAP script is loaded. The animation will not run.
Track 1 has 5 timed elements in this HTML file. Smaller sub-compositions keep timelines easier to read, iterate on, and diff.
findings.fixHint: Move coherent scene groups into separate .html files under compositions/ and mount them from the parent with data-composition-src so the timeline stays easier to inspect, revise, and validate.

findings.message: querySelector uses a template literal variable (e.g. `${compId}`). The HTML bundler's CSS parser crashes on these. Use a hardcoded string instead.
findings.fixHint: Replace the template literal variable with a hardcoded string. The bundler's CSS parser cannot handle interpolated variables in script content.

findings.message: <section> is a timeline element that contains nested <div>. The timeline shows one row per top-level element, and the root composition is built only from sub-compositions.
findings.fixHint: Move <section> and its contents into a sub-composition file and mount it with data-composition-src.

findings.message: Nothing on screen moved under seek.
findings.fixHint: If the composition is meant to be still, add `data-no-timeline` to the element with `data-composition-id`. Otherwise confirm it seeks a paused GSAP/CSS timeline under `data-*` timing attributes rather than only autoplaying.

findings.message: Type floor is 28 px (2.6% of the 1080 px short side, what a phone can read) and 2 text elements stay under it for 0.5 s or more, the smallest "Play. Compete. Repeat." at 24 px: set reading text to at least 28 px, or put data-layout-ignore on text that is texture rather than reading; see references/look.md.
